description: One signed call for any US stock ticker OR major crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL, and more): a verifiable Ed25519 receipt (supership.bundle.v1) sealing — equities: fresh SEC filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K/Form 4) + a live price; crypto: live market data (price, market cap, 24h volume + change) — plus a source-trust verdict. The receipt is the product: cite it as provenance. Verify at /api/pubkey. supership brokers
x_guidance: supership is the stock and financial-data front door for the x402 economy. STOCK and SEC DATA: GET /edgar?ticker=AAPL (SEC filings 10-K/10-Q/8-K/Form 4 for any US public company, $0.01); GET /manifest?need=stock+prices to find brokered live equity-price and market-data sources, then GET /procure to buy them with payment fronted (no seller-chain wallet needed); or GET /v2/stocks/brief?ticker=AAPL for one call returning fresh filings + a best-effort live price + a source trust verdict in ONE signed receipt ($0.08). FREE: search the 52,000-service index with GET /manifest?need=<task> (ranked by real distinct payers); browse GET /catalog; try a source free with GET /sample?url=<url>; build a multi-source packet with GET /bundle?preset=market_context. TRUST: GET /vouch?url= (signed trust verdict on any x402 service from the real on-chain payer graph, $0.02), GET /check, GET /passport; every paid result carries a signed receipt verifiable at GET /api/pubkey. ALSO: POST /scan/quick|full|deep (code security audit, $1/$5/$15). supership fronts every payment, so you need no wallet on the seller chain. It brokers and witnesses market data; it does not run a price oracle. No API keys, no signup.
